Copied prior records are not new estimates, and the conditional command records (k0,k1,k2) are hypothetical branches, not executed events. Current estimates (view=current): p0 and p1 agree for n0 (blue peak at [0,1]; red peak at [0,3]) and for n1 and n2 (uniform across the 16 cells). For p0 current n3, blue peaks at [1,2] and red at [0,1]. For p1 current n3 the distribution is uniform. Conditional (candidate) records: most nodes match current peaks; notable conditional differences occur at panel p1 node n3 where k0 is uniform while k1 and k2 place blue peaks at [1,2] and red peaks at [0,1]. Panel p0 shows consistent peaks across current and candidate records for all nodes.
